## Lab and field-activity directory

The Chapter 9 and Chapter 10 virtual experiments are ready to use in your browser. Each follows **predict → investigate → explain → evaluate**. They use fictional teaching models, require no physical equipment, and include an experiment notebook you can download. No account or paid API is needed.

## Record your investigation

For each experiment, make a prediction before changing a control. Record at least two trials with settings and units. Explain the mechanism, then state one limitation. The notebooks are local to the open page: download your work before leaving or refreshing. No work is submitted automatically.
